name: Le Bandit

features.name: Golden squares
features.description: Winning positions turn golden; Super Cascades and coin symbols interact with golden squares to reveal values.

features.name: Rainbow symbols
features.description: Activate golden squares to reveal coins, clovers and pots.

review:
Smokey the raccoon thief on a cluster-pays grid – the game that started the whole Le series. Wins leave golden squares behind, and when a rainbow symbol lands, those squares light up to reveal cash prizes or multipliers.

It's more playful and less brutal than Hacksaw's most extreme games, which makes it a great entry point. Watching the squares build and waiting for the rainbow never gets old. Medium volatility, 10,000x max, 96.34% RTP.
pros: A little less extreme than other Hacksaw hits
cons: Features can take a while to make sense
